29962-celebrity.title: Celebrity
29962-celebrity.creator: James McKimmey, Jr.
29962-celebrity.description: A book by James McKimmey, Jr.. slammed again, and half-consumed cups of coffee lay cooling behind. Children wiped at sleepy eyes and mothers swept crumbs, touching self-conscious fingers at their own bed-ruffled hair. Laborers and clerks and lawyers and doctors strode down sidewalks and climbed into automobiles and busses and sleek-nosed elevated trains. To the center of the city, where the tall buildings stretched to the lighting sky, came the horde, like thousands of ants toward a comb of honey. Wheels sang and whined.

arxiv-2109-07971.title: Do Language Models Know the Way to Rome?
arxiv-2109-07971.creator: Bastien Liétard, Mostafa Abdou, Anders Søgaard
arxiv-2109-07971.description: Abstract The global geometry of language models is important for a range of applications, but language model probes tend to evaluate rather local relations, for which ground truths are easily obtained. In this paper we exploit the fact that in geography, ground truths are available beyond local relations.

arxiv-2210-04944.title: Masked Autoencoders for Low dose CT denoising
arxiv-2210-04944.creator: Dayang Wang, Yongshun Xu, Shuo Han, Hengyong Yu*
arxiv-2210-04944.description: Abstract Low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) reduces the X-ray radiation but compromises image quality with more noises and artifacts. A plethora of transformer models have been developed recently to improve LDCT image quality. However, the success of a transformer model relies on a large amount of paired noisy and clean data, which is often unavailable in clinical applications.

arxiv-2402-18331.title: FineDiffusion: Scaling up Diffusion Models for Fine-grained Image Generation with 10,000 Classes
arxiv-2402-18331.creator: Ziying Pan, Kun Wang, Gang Li, Feihong He, Yongxuan Lai
arxiv-2402-18331.description: Abstract The class-conditional image generation based on diffusion models is renowned for generating high-quality and diverse images. However, most prior efforts focus on generating images for general categories, e.g., 1000 classes in ImageNet-1k. A more challenging task, large-scale fine-grained image generation, remains the boundary to explore.

arxiv-2410-19908.title: SIROCCO: A Publicly Available Monte Carlo Ionization and Radiative Transfer Code for Astrophysical Outflows
arxiv-2410-19908.creator: James H. Matthews, Knox S. Long, Christian Knigge, Stuart A. Sim, Edward J. Parkinson, Nick Higginbottom, Samuel W. Mangham, Nicolas Scepi, Austen Wallis, Henrietta A. Hewitt Amin Mosallanezhad
arxiv-2410-19908.description: Abstract Outflows are critical components of many astrophysical systems, including accreting compact binaries and active galactic nuclei (AGN). These outflows can significantly affect a system’s evolution and alter its observational appearance by reprocessing the radiation produced by the central engine.

arxiv-2412-14822.title: 𝓝 = 𝟐 \mathcal{N}=2 superconformal gravitino in harmonic superspace
arxiv-2412-14822.creator: Evgeny Ivanov, Nikita Zaigraev
arxiv-2412-14822.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Evgeny Ivanov, Nikita Zaigraev. We present the harmonic superspace formulation of 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 gravitino multiplet, the simplest 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 half-integer spin gauge supermultiplet. It is shown that, quite similar to other 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 gauge multiplets, the gravitino supermultiplet is described by unconstrained analytic prepotentials h + + α h^{++\alpha} and h + + + h^{+++} which contain a conformal gravitino in the Wess-Zumino gauge.

arxiv-2508-02018.title: SpeechR: A Benchmark for Speech Reasoning in Large Audio-Language Models
arxiv-2508-02018.creator: Wanqi Yang, Yanda Li, Yunchao Wei, Meng Fang, Ling Chen
arxiv-2508-02018.description: Abstract Large audio–language models (LALMs) have achieved near-human performance in sentence-level transcription and emotion recognition. However, existing evaluations focus mainly on surface-level perception, leaving the capacity of models for contextual and inference-driven reasoning in speech-based scenarios insufficiently examined. To address this gap, we introduce SpeechR, a unified benchmark for evaluating reasoning over speech in large audio-language models.

arxiv-2601-03125.title: An 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) quasi-Ewald splitting method for nanoconfined electrostatics Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2601-03125.creator: Zecheng Gan, Xuanzhao Gao, Yuqing Li
arxiv-2601-03125.description: Abstract Simulating the dynamics of charged particles in quasi-two-dimensional (quasi-2D) nanoconfined systems presents a significant computational challenge due to the long-range nature of electrostatic interactions and the geometric anisotropy. To address this, we introduce a novel quasi-Ewald splitting strategy tailored for particle-based simulations in such geometry.

pmc-11518696.title: Effects of E2 on the IDO1‐mediated metabolic KYN pathway in OVX female mice
pmc-11518696.creator: Xi Jiang, Xuefeng Yu, Shuran Hu, Huidan Dai, Hanqin Zhang, Yuyang Hang, Xupei Xie, Yubo Yang, Fan Wu
pmc-11518696.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The aim of this study was to investigate the role of 17β‐estradiol (E2)‐mediated oestrogen receptor (ER) in modulating the depressive‐like behaviours of ovariectomy (OVX) mice and the associated mechanisms. E2 was administrated in OVX mice. The behaviour and physiological changes of OVX mice including immobility time in tail suspension test (TST) and forced swimming test (FST), levels of serum E2, inflammatory mediators, oxidative stress factors, indoleamine2,3‐dioxygenase 1 (IDO1) and the neurotransmitters mediated by IDO1 activation were then recorded.

pmc-11640490.title: Advancing Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome (IC/BPS) Diagnosis: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Methodologies
pmc-11640490.creator: Joseph J Janicki, Bernadette M M Zwaans, Sarah N Bartolone, Elijah P Ward, Michael B Chancellor
pmc-11640490.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objectives. This study aimed to improve machine learning models for diagnosing interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome (IC/BPS) by comparing classical machine learning methods with newer AutoML approaches, utilizing biomarker data and patient-reported outcomes as features. We applied various machine learning techniques to biomarker data from the previous IP4IC and ICRS studies to predict the presence of IC/BPS, a disorder impacting the urinary bladder. Data were sourced from two nationwide, crowd-sourced collections of urine samples involving 2009 participants.

pmc-12475837.title: Dietary exposure to lambda-cyhalothrin induces intestinal damage in chickens via oxidative stress and gut microbiota dysbiosis☆
pmc-12475837.creator: Wen Zhang, Qiaochu Sun, Huayu Zhang, Tianning Luo, Yixin Zhang, Fucheng Wang, Haoran Zhang, Runxiang Zhang
pmc-12475837.description: Lambda-cyhalothrin (LCT), a widely used pyrethroid insecticide for ectoparasite control in poultry and sanitation pest management, poses health risks to humans and animals despite its broad application. While LCT’s intestinal toxicity has been underexplored, this study innovatively highlights dose-dependent differences in its effects through a novel chicken exposure model.

pmc-13157101.title: Neonatal small extracellular vesicle-loaded GelNB hydrogel reprograms the vascular-immune microenvironment for spinal cord injury repair
pmc-13157101.creator: Feifei Yuan, Chaoran Shi, Xisong Liang, Jiaqi Xu, Yiming Qin, Sheng Xu, Yong Chen, Tian Qin, Yinghe Ding, Zhiyu Hu, Chengjun Li, Hongbin Lu, Jianzhong Hu, Yong Cao
pmc-13157101.description: Adult mammals with spinal cord injury (SCI) face permanent disability from failed regeneration and scarring, while neonatal mice achieve scarless repair. We show neonatal mouse circulating blood-derived small extracellular vesicles (NCE) rejuvenate adult spinal cord microvascular endothelial cells (SCMECs), restoring lipid metabolism, easing immune imbalance, and supporting neuroaxonal regrowth.

pmc-13186806.title: Optimal Preservation Method for Long-term Preservation in ddH2O and Starvation Adaptive Mechanisms of Flavobacterium columnare Revealed by Multi-omic Analysis
pmc-13186806.creator: Shengnan Gao, Liang Zhong, Yuxuan Zhang, Ruoxi Zhu, Yanwen Shao, Runsheng Li, Yongtao Zhu, Wenlong Cai
pmc-13186806.description: Aquatic bacterial pathogens cause recurrent diseases in aquaculture. However, their survival dynamics and adaptive mechanisms in nutrient-limited aquatic environments remain poorly understood. In this study, we used Flavobacterium columnare, the causative agent of columnare disease, as an example to study multi-level (morphological, genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic) adaptive changes during prolonged starvation.

pmc-13368400.title: The past, present, and future of Alzheimer's disease—part 3: the future
pmc-13368400.creator: Ricardo Nitrini, Leonel Tadao Takada, Sonia Maria Dozzi Brucki
pmc-13368400.description: Predicting future advances in science is practically impossible because unexpected discoveries can radically change the march of ongoing processes. First, the diagnosis of risk factors for Alzheimer's disease (AD), based on the preponderant role of genetics, will be made very early.

pmc-13471191.title: Protocol to determine oligomerization states of proteins in living cells using photon counting histogram analysis
pmc-13471191.creator: Zixiao Li, Tyler Camp, Yushan Li, Kai Zhang
pmc-13471191.description: SummaryDetermining protein oligomerization states in living cells is essential for understanding cell signaling and disease pathology, but it remains technically challenging. Here, we present a protocol for quantifying the oligomeric states of HaloTag-labeled proteins in living mammalian cells using fluorescence fluctuation spectroscopy (FFS) and photon counting histogram (PCH) analysis.

pmc-13689033.creator: Saaed Abunada, Omar Abunada, Fnu Vivek, Lakhveer Rathi, Fnu Muskan, Jiyanth Parkash, Saqlain Nazeer, Fnu Anchal, Fnu Danial, Kashish Turesh, Amjad Ali, Faizan Qureshi, Mahir Tesfaye
pmc-13689033.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a growing global health challenge, necessitating effective therapies that improve glycemic control and promote weight loss. Ecnoglutide, a novel cAMP-biased GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) receptor agonist, has emerged as a promising therapeutic option.MethodsA systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) was conducted following PRISMA and AMSTAR-2 guidelines.

pmc-7617921.title: Preliminary Professional Competency Standards for Occupational Therapists in India: A Global Review and Adaptation

pmc-7617921.description: BackgroundCompetency is the ability to apply knowledge and skills efficiently to achieve required outcomes, typically measured through performance. Professional competency standards in healthcare describe the specific knowledge, skills, and attributes required for practice. In India, the occupational therapy (OT) profession is gaining recognition, highlighting a need for national competency standards to improve quality of care and professional visibility.
